{{reconstructed}}
==Proto-Semitic==

===Etymology===
Reconstructed in Militarev & Kogan's ''Semitic Etymological Dictionary'' as {{m|sem-pro|*bVʕVr-}}. The SED notes that a cluster of semantically similar forms lacking the {{m|sem-pro|*ʕ}} (Akkadian {{m|akk|bīru}}, Mandaic {{m|myz|ࡁࡉࡓࡀ|tr=bira}}, and several Ethiopian Semitic forms such as Amharic {{m|am|በሬ|tr=bäre}}) may continue a separate, though probably related, root.

===Noun===
{{sem-noun|m}}

# [[household]] [[animal]]
# [[beast of burden]]

{{sem-decl-noun}}
